goals: Locally authored exact differential requiring native output and a 65536-byte small-island threshold.
Static property root observations target guarded extraction of x={a,b} and y={b,c}; no namespace reflection or exported callable then is required.

A private then local, exported through the readThen alias, and callable __proto__/init export names preserve values and object identity without colliding with private availability helpers; the separate barrels case covers the conservative exported-then fallback.
